issues.explanation: Nora says she worked five years scrubbing floors at Julian's hotel, but Julian only bought the hotel 'last week' in Ep1, so he could not have owned it for five years. Her line may only mean she worked there for five years, but 'your hotel' conflicts with the recent purchase.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the line to 'For five years I scrubbed floors in that hotel to feed your son.'

issues.explanation: Nora's age goes from 31 in Ep4 to 32 in Ep5 with no time jump, even though the story appears to run continuously (same night, same photo/ultimatum).
issues.suggested_fix: Set Nora's age to a single consistent number across episodes (e.g., 31 in Ep5).

issues.explanation: Julian is 34 in Ep4 but 35 in Ep5 with no time passing between the episodes.
issues.suggested_fix: Use the same age for Julian in Ep5 (34).

issues.explanation: Sienna is 29 in Ep4 but 30 in Ep5, with no on-screen time passing. Her age has also changed across all earlier episodes (30, 31, 28, 29).
issues.suggested_fix: Fix Sienna's age at one number (e.g., 29) in all episodes.

issues.explanation: Marcus is 45 in Ep4 but described as in his 50s in Ep5.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Marcus's description in Ep5 to '(45, hotel manager, rumpled suit)'.

issues.explanation: Julian says he has always known about Leo being kept from him by his mother, but Ep4 shows him unaware that Leo is his son. However, he is only claiming Celeste knew, not that he knew, so both can be true.
Julian is shown adoption papers with his signature; this is a new reveal and not inconsistent with earlier facts, since he never knew Leo before.
